def check_constraints():
    from z3 import Solver, Int, Bool, Or, Not, And, sat

    # Base script variables
    ectx_params = Int('ectx_params')

    # Constraint set 2 variables
    check = Bool('check')
    check_named = Bool('check_named')
    text = Bool('text')
    list_curves = Bool('list_curves')
    no_seed = Bool('no_seed')
    point_format = Bool('point_format')

    pctx_nonnull = Bool('pctx_nonnull')
    params_key_nonnull = Bool('params_key_nonnull')
    out_nonnull = Bool('out_nonnull')
    curve_name_nonnull = Bool('curve_name_nonnull')
    asn1_encoding_nonnull = Bool('asn1_encoding_nonnull')
    gctx_params_nonnull = Bool('gctx_params_nonnull')

    EVP_PKEY_param_check_ret = Int('EVP_PKEY_param_check_ret')
    EVP_PKEY_set_utf8_string_param_ret = Int('EVP_PKEY_set_utf8_string_param_ret')
    EVP_PKEY_print_params_ret = Int('EVP_PKEY_print_params_ret')
    EVP_PKEY_set_octet_string_param_ret = Int('EVP_PKEY_set_octet_string_param_ret')
    EVP_PKEY_keygen_init_ret = Int('EVP_PKEY_keygen_init_ret')
    EVP_PKEY_CTX_set_params_ret = Int('EVP_PKEY_CTX_set_params_ret')
    EVP_PKEY_keygen_ret = Int('EVP_PKEY_keygen_ret')

    app_RAND_load_ret = Bool('app_RAND_load_ret')
    opt_check_rest_arg_ret = Bool('opt_check_rest_arg_ret')
    opt_provider_ret = Bool('opt_provider_ret')
    opt_rand_ret = Bool('opt_rand_ret')
    opt_string_asn1_ret = Bool('opt_string_asn1_ret')
    opt_string_point_format_ret = Bool('opt_string_point_format_ret')
    opt_format_out_ret = Bool('opt_format_out_ret')
    opt_format_in_ret = Bool('opt_format_in_ret')

    s = Solver()

    # Base script constraint
    s.add(ectx_params == 0)

    # Constraint 1
    s.add(Or(Not(Or(check, check_named)),
             Not(Or(Not(pctx_nonnull), EVP_PKEY_param_check_ret <= 0))))

    # Constraint 2
    s.add(Or(Not(Or(check, check_named)),
             Not(And(check_named, EVP_PKEY_set_utf8_string_param_ret == 0))))

    # Constraint 3
    s.add(Not(And(text, EVP_PKEY_print_params_ret == 0)))

    # Constraint 4
    s.add(Not(list_curves))

    # Constraint 5
    s.add(out_nonnull)

    # Constraint 6
    s.add(Not(And(no_seed, EVP_PKEY_set_octet_string_param_ret == 0)))

    # Constraint 7
    s.add(Or(Not(curve_name_nonnull),
             Not(And(asn1_encoding_nonnull, EVP_PKEY_set_utf8_string_param_ret == 0))))

    # Constraint 8
    s.add(Or(Not(curve_name_nonnull),
             Not(And(point_format, EVP_PKEY_set_utf8_string_param_ret == 0))))

    # Constraint 9
    s.add(Or(Not(curve_name_nonnull), params_key_nonnull))

    # Constraint 10
    s.add(Or(Not(curve_name_nonnull),
             Not(Or(Not(gctx_params_nonnull),
                    EVP_PKEY_keygen_init_ret <= 0,
                    EVP_PKEY_CTX_set_params_ret <= 0,
                    EVP_PKEY_keygen_ret <= 0))))

    # Constraint 11
    s.add(app_RAND_load_ret)

    # Constraint 12
    s.add(opt_check_rest_arg_ret)

    # Constraint 13
    s.add(opt_provider_ret)

    # Constraint 14
    s.add(opt_rand_ret)

    # Constraint 15
    s.add(opt_string_asn1_ret)

    # Constraint 16
    s.add(opt_string_point_format_ret)

    # Constraint 17
    s.add(opt_format_out_ret)

    # Constraint 18
    s.add(opt_format_in_ret)

    return s.check() == sat
